snippet.title: Steam Trailer for Euro3v3 | Community Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Euro3v3: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2870600/Euro3v3/
What does your dream team look like?

This trailer is made up entirely of clips the community has send in.
Thanks to everyone sending in clips for this trailer! 

Euro3v3 is the ultimate teamwork multiplayer FPS. Heal your teammates by shooting them. Boost them. Build your defense together.

Music
 'Neon' by Scott Buckley - released under CC-BY 4.0. www.scottbuckley.com.au
